title: Two Islands, One Bridge — solved
description: Both missing static routes added, then the sign-off ping crossing all four devices: PC-Red → Router-Red → Router-Blue → PC-Blue.

steps.note: Hold on the broken starting state: two networks, no route between them.
Router-Red learns the way to the blue network, via its backbone neighbour.
The mirror route. Without it the request arrives and the reply can't get home.
Every objective is green — the lab now asks for the proving ping.
The lab's sign-off ping. Four hops across the canvas, then the win bar.
